description.value: An Epic Boss takes one Epic Action at the end of each player character's turn. At the game master's discretion, an Epic Boss may take an Epic Action after another non-player character combatant's turn, such as a sidekick or major NPC ally of the player characters.

Therefore, if an Epic Boss were facing five player characters, the boss would take five Epic Actions total during one round of combat, one at the end of each player character's turn. If a player character falls Unconscious or dies during the encounter, the Epic Boss continues taking an Epic Action after that character's place in the Initiative order.

Some Epic Actions can only be used once per round, and others may have a recharge condition. In addition, certain Epic Actions must be used as the first or last Epic Action the boss takes that round. For example, a __Delerium Dragon__ may only use its Breath Weapon as the final Epic Action it takes that round.

Epic Actions are not Reactions. Game effects which prevent an Epic Boss from taking Reactions do not work on Epic Actions, nor do game affects which limit a creature to taking only a movement, Bonus Action, or action on their turn (such as the Dazed condition).

description.name: Wounds in Grim Hollow
description.value: Grievous Wounds are applied to characters that would be dropped to 0 Hit Points, but instead choose to gain a lingering wound that stays with them. These wounds remain until a character takes a Long Rest (see Resting below) and undergoes treatment by a physician or someone trained in *Medicine*.

Permanent Wounds occur when a creature takes multiple Grievous Wounds, or when a character dies and is brought back to life. The challenges of Permanent Wounds can be offset with certain magic items or prosthetics.

description.name: Rests in Grim Hollow
description.value: The dark-fantasy vibe of Grim Hollow necessitates a change to the effects of Short and Long Rests. Grievous Wounds can be healed by taking a Long Rest, but those rests in Grim Hollow take 32 hours of resting in a completely safe environment.
